jtlshopplugin.Name: Invoice-api xhub for JTL-Shop
jtlshopplugin.Description: Generate compliant e-invoices from JTL-Shop orders via the invoice-api.xhub.io API. Live now: PDF, XRechnung, ZUGFeRD.
jtlshopplugin.Author: xhub.io / BeeBack UG

Descriptions.Description: E-Rechnungen aus JTL-Shop-Bestellungen ueber die invoice-api.xhub.io API erzeugen. Aktuell live: PDF, XRechnung, ZUGFeRD.
Generate compliant e-invoices from JTL-Shop orders via the invoice-api.xhub.io API. Live now: PDF, XRechnung, ZUGFeRD.

Setting.Name: API key
Setting.Description: Generate at https://console.invoice-api.xhub.io/api-keys. The key is used as a Bearer token for every API call.

Setting.Name: API base URL
Setting.Description: Default https://service.invoice-api.xhub.io. Only change for staging or self-hosted deployments.

Setting.Name: Country
Setting.Description: Country profile used for the generated e-invoice. Determines validation rules and country-specific fields.

Setting.Name: Format
Setting.Description: Currently 3 e-invoice formats can be generated: PDF, XRechnung, ZUGFeRD. Additional formats (Factur-X, FatturaPA, Facturae, ebInterface, UBL, ISDOC, NAV) follow from Q3 2026 onwards and will appear automatically once the backend supports them.

Setting.Name: Trigger
Setting.Description: Pick the order state that should trigger invoice generation. Stripe / PayPal / instant-pay -> processing or completed. Advance bank transfer -> on hold so the customer receives the invoice with bank details before paying. For mixed payment methods, completed is the safest compromise.

SelectboxOptions.Option: When order is pending (rare - pre-invoice flow)
When order is on hold (advance payment with bank details)
When order goes to processing (Stripe / PayPal / instant-pay)
When order is completed (default - invoice on shipment)

Setting.Name: Attach invoice to customer email
Setting.Description: When enabled, the generated invoice is attached to the order confirmation / status-change email sent by JTL-Shop.

Setting.Name: Payment due (days)
Setting.Description: Number of days from the invoice date until the payment due date. Default 14.

Setting.Name: Number format
Setting.Description: Format string for the invoice number. Tokens: {order_number}, {order_id}, {year}, {month}, {day}, {seq}, {seq:0000}. For Section 14 UStG (DE) compliance use {seq} or {seq:0000} - the plugin tracks a separate sequential counter that is uniquely incremented per generated invoice. Example: 2026-{seq:0000} -> 2026-0001, 2026-0002.

Setting.Name: Sequence reset
Setting.Description: Determines when the {seq} counter resets. Yearly is recommended and aligns with most accounting practices.

Setting.Name: Company name
Setting.Description: Legal company name as it should appear on the invoice header.

Setting.Name: VAT ID
Setting.Description: EU VAT identification number (e.g. DE123456789). Required for cross-border B2B invoices.

Setting.Name: Street
Setting.Description: Street and house number of your business address.

Setting.Name: Postal code
Setting.Description: Postal/ZIP code of your business address.

Setting.Name: City
Setting.Description: City of your business address.

Setting.Name: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
Setting.Description: Two-letter ISO country code of your business address (e.g. DE, AT, CH).

Setting.Name: Email
Setting.Description: Business email shown on the invoice for queries and remittance.

Setting.Name: Phone
Setting.Description: Required by some country profiles (e.g. XRechnung B2G). Format: +49 30 1234567 - international notation recommended.

Setting.Name: IBAN
Setting.Description: Optional. Used for advance bank transfer so the customer receives the invoice with IBAN and BIC. If left empty, the plugin tries to read these from the active JTL-Shop payment methods.

Setting.Name: BIC
Setting.Description: Bank Identifier Code (SWIFT). Required alongside IBAN for international transfers.

Setting.Name: Bank name
Setting.Description: Name of the bank as it should appear on the invoice payment block.

Setting.Name: Account holder
Setting.Description: Name of the account holder. Often identical to the company name; provide explicitly if it differs.

Setting.Name: Default Leitweg-ID
Setting.Description: Used by XRechnung for B2G (public sector). Format 991-12345-67. Leave empty for B2B - the order number is then used as buyer reference.

Setting.Name: Default Template-ID
Setting.Description: Optional. Leave empty to use the standard invoice template provided by invoice-api.xhub.io. To use your own template (logo, layout, colors, content blocks), create one at https://console.invoice-api.xhub.io/pdf/templates and paste its UUID here. Templates are format-specific - a template designed for XRechnung will not work for ZUGFeRD or PDF.
